source: Alternatively, the example below shows how to use {0} to access and send cookies to the API from a server-side request (originating on the client). Using an isomorphic {1} call, we ensure that the API endpoint has access to the same {2} header originally sent by the user's browser. This is only necessary if you aren't using {3}.
